title: Complete Utility and Cleaning Equipment Bay
description: One complete static public-service utility and cleaning-equipment preparation bay, counted as one scene and zero new independent models. Four full original assets stand at unit scale on a single finite floor: a complete offset-basin sink at rear left, a whole wheeled side-press cleaning bucket separately at front left, a full upright floor cleaner at rear right, and an entire single-disc buffer at front right. The paired left and right stations leave an actual broad central open aisle and finite fore-aft gaps, not the three inline stations of the earlier dishwashing scene renamed. All source GLB raw buffers, local POSITION/NORMAL, PBR material dictionaries, face assignments and internal hierarchies are preserved byte-exact. Only whole-model translations and a scene-only support slab are new. No asset is extracted, resized, recoloured or counted as a new prop. Static empty equipment display only: no plumbing connections, water, chemicals, cleaning or hygiene sequence, machine operation, suction, electrical, load, stability or safety certification. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made.
